//: SAMPLE instance config for the sp-list-to-markdown task. Copy it, fill in the YOUR-... values, save it where the page's visitors can read it (e.g. the site's SiteAssets/admin-tasks/intake.json), and point the web part's data-config at it. Keys starting with // are notes: the runner ignores them, so this file works as-is. Column names are INTERNAL names (List settings > column > the Field= value in the URL). Full reference: docs/03-sp-list-to-markdown.md. Editing this file takes effect at the next check; it does not trigger an export by itself - visit the page with ?adminTasks=force for that.
//title: Optional. The H1 of the Markdown file. Default: the list title.
title: Intake requests
//list: site: optional, server-relative; default is the page's own site, and "/" means the tenant root site. title: required, the list's display title.
//fields: Required. The columns to write for each item, in this order. Group and subgroup columns are added to every item automatically, so Copilot never loses them.
//heading: Optional. The column used as each item's heading. Default: Title.
heading: Title
//group: Optional. Column for ## sections (e.g. the assignee). Omit or "" for no grouping. Blank values land in a '(none)' group, sorted last.
//subgroup: Optional. Column for ### sections inside each group (e.g. Status). Omit for none.
//filter: Optional. An OData $filter, passed as-is. Examples: "Status ne 'Closed'", "Status eq 'New' or Status eq 'In progress'". Omit to export every item (up to maxItems). Filtered columns should be indexed once a list passes 5,000 items.
//orderBy: Optional. One or more { field, ascending } (or just a column name for ascending). Default: ID descending, i.e. newest first. Sorted columns should be indexed once a list passes 5,000 items.
//maxItems: Optional. 1-5000, read in one request; default 50. When the limit is hit the file says so.
//timeZone: Optional. IANA zone for date+time values. Default: the zone of whichever browser runs the export, so set it. Date-only columns ignore it.
//output: Required. folder: server-relative folder for the .md file (it must exist). file: the file name, overwritten on each export. site: optional, default list.site. IMPORTANT: Copilot follows the FILE's permissions, so use a library whose readers are exactly the list's readers. Leave the file's Title column alone: each export writes its 'Source list as of ...' time there.
//schedule: Optional (runner setting). slots: local hours at which a new check may happen; default 8,10,12,14,16,18. until: the hour the day closes, nothing starts at or after it; default two hours after the last slot (20). Weekends are included.
//label: Optional (runner setting). The name shown for this task in the status panel. Default: 'Export list to Markdown'.
label: Export intake list to Markdown
//data-id: Not a config key: the runner remembers each instance by the web part's data-config URL. Only if that URL changes on every load (it never should for a real file) add data-id="some-name" to the web part's <div>.
